title: American Rivers Datasets
description: A collection of five U.S. river vector datasets compiled by American Rivers: a point database of 2,126 dam removals (1912–2025), two snapshots of the National Park Service Nationwide Rivers Inventory (NRI 2016 and 2024) cataloguing free-flowing segments assessed for Wild and Scenic River designation, a dataset of all formally designated Wild and Scenic River segments, and a dataset of segments found eligible or suitable for designation. All datasets have national coverage including Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico.
